title: The Coffee Maker That Leaked
漏水的咖啡機
paras: Claire had worked on the Kitchen Corner support line for three years, and she could tell from his first sentence that Mr. Novak was angry. "My coffee maker is two weeks old," he said. "It leaks all over the counter, and when it doesn't, it brews so {{poorly|poorly}} that the coffee tastes like water. It's {{defective|defective}}, and I want my money back."
克萊兒在 Kitchen Corner 的客服專線工作了三年，光聽第一句話就知道諾瓦克先生在生氣。「我的咖啡機才買兩個星期，」他說，「它會漏得整個檯面都是水，不漏的時候，煮出來的咖啡又淡得像水。它有瑕疵，我要退錢。」

"I'm sorry about that," Claire said. "I know you've been on hold for twenty minutes, and I appreciate your {{patience|patience}}. Let me pull up your order." Mr. Novak sighed. "I've bought your brand for years, and it's always been {{dependable|dependable}}. That's why this makes me so angry. Your website said 'built to last.' I feel I was {{mislead|misled}}."
「真的很抱歉，」克萊兒說，「我知道您已經等了二十分鐘，謝謝您的耐心等候。讓我調出您的訂單。」諾瓦克先生嘆了口氣。「我買你們的牌子買了好幾年，一直都很可靠，所以這次才這麼火大。你們的網站寫『經久耐用』，我覺得自己被誤導了。」

"Do you still have the receipt?" she asked. "I must have {{misplace|misplaced}} it," Mr. Novak admitted. "No problem," Claire said. "I can find the order by your email. And the {{warranty|warranty}} covers a full year, so you have two choices: a full {{refund|refund}}, or a {{replacement|replacement}}."
「您還留著收據嗎？」她問。「我八成是不知道放到哪裡去了。」諾瓦克先生承認。「沒關係，我可以用您的電子郵件查到訂單。而且保固期是整整一年，所以您有兩個選擇：全額退款，或是換一台新的。」

Mr. Novak was quiet for a moment. "I like that model," he said at last. "Send the new one." It arrived on Thursday. On Friday morning, he sent a short email: the coffee was hot and strong, and nothing leaked.
諾瓦克先生靜了一會兒。「我很喜歡那個型號，」他終於說，「寄新的來吧。」新機器週四送到。週五早上，他寄來一封簡短的電子郵件：咖啡又熱又濃，一滴都沒漏。
